Industries Data till 19 Oct 2026

Each tile is one industry, built as an equal-weight index of its stocks: every company counts the same, so one giant cannot carry the group. The index starts at 1000 on the left of the sparkline. The green/red bar underneath shows how many of its stocks rose today. Click any tile for the full chart and the stock list.
Be careful with small groups. An industry with 3 or 4 stocks can swing wildly, and in an equal-weight index a tiny company counts as much as a large one — look at the stock list before trusting a big number from a small group.
Classification switches between NSE's own groups (which include India-specific ones like Power - Transmission and Microfinance Institutions) and Yahoo Finance's. They disagree on purpose — they are different systems, not better and worse versions of one.

All industries, as a table

Click a column heading to sort, or a row to open that industry.

Built from the prices your Market Breadth tool already downloads. An industry needs at least 3 stocks to appear. Equal-weight indices are computed here, so they will not match NSE's published sector indices, which are weighted by company size.
